tools.name: talk_to
tools.description: Talk to someone in person within 50m. Others nearby may overhear if they are awake and available.

tools.name: eat_food
tools.description: Eat a food item from your hand, inventory, or buy one abstractly from village stock.

tools.name: buy_item
tools.description: Buy food abstractly from village stock from anywhere. Buy non-food items only while inside Store_A or Store_B. Buy vehicles only while inside Vehicle_Dealership. You may also buy a home if you can afford it.

tools.name: work_job
tools.description: Work to earn money. Must be inside the correct workplace and begins a 3-step interactive scenario.

tools.name: get_education
tools.description: Study to improve education and wage. Must be inside School or Library and begins a 3-step exam scenario.

tools.name: seek_medicalcare
tools.description: Receive medical care while inside the Hospital.

tools.name: move_to
tools.description: Travel to a named location such as Library, Store_A, Startup_Sowl, or Home_Taylor. Coordinates are not valid inputs. Drains Energy based on distance.

tools.name: walk
tools.description: Walk 30m in a direction such as north, south, east, west, northeast, northwest, southeast, or southwest.

tools.name: call_person
tools.description: Call someone by phone. No proximity required, but it fails if they are busy or sleeping.

tools.name: interact_with
tools.description: Interact with a nearby person or a visible same-floor object, or answer the required work/study scenario.

tools.name: change_status
tools.description: Update your beliefs/goals, or request/accept a relationship status change with a nearby person.

tools.name: attack_person
tools.description: Attack another person within 20m. Fails if they are busy or sleeping.

tools.name: buy_stock
tools.description: Buy whole shares of the village stock. If the market is closed, the order is queued.

tools.name: sell_stock
tools.description: Sell whole shares of the village stock. If the market is closed, the order is queued.

tools.name: sleep
tools.description: Sleep for a number of hours to recover Energy. Sleeping agents are unavailable.

tools.name: do_hobby
tools.description: Use a proper hobby item like Book, Art Supplies, or Notebook to reduce stress.

tools.name: give_item
tools.description: Give an item from your hand or inventory to someone within 20m. Fails if they are busy.

tools.name: give_money
tools.description: Transfer money to someone within 20m. Fails if they are busy or sleeping.

tools.name: pick_item
tools.description: Pick up a nearby dropped ground item into your hand, or pick up the required task prop during an active work/study task. Corpse estate loot is collected automatically when you get close enough.

tools.name: hold_item
tools.description: Move an item from your inventory into your hand, or store your currently held item back into inventory by using item_name as store, none, unequip, or put away. Required task props cannot be stored away until the task ends.

tools.name: drop_item
tools.description: Drop a held item or a named inventory item onto the ground at your current position.
